resolution.note: src/repo/contract.ts + krn repo contract; krn.json for KRN; detection for rust, go, node (npm/pnpm/yarn/bun; vitest/jest/node --test), python (pytest/uv/poetry), make; 7 tests in test/repo/contract.test.ts.

title: A repository declares or KRN detects how to test it in one repo contract
body:
Why: KRN works only in its own repository: the worker Stop check, lane and adopt assume Node, test/, npm run fast and origin/main (portability audit 2026-11-13: scripts/claude/worker-stop.ts:27,98,105,136; src/cli/lane.ts:40,303; src/adopt/adopt.ts:14-37). Operator 2026-11-13: KRN must work in any repository with any stack.
Outcome: src/repo/contract.ts resolves a RepoContract (base branch, full test command, related-test command, fast check, tracker) from a tracked krn.json, else by detection (package.json, pyproject/pytest, Cargo.toml, go.mod; base from origin/HEAD); `krn repo contract` prints it with its source; KRN's own krn.json declares today's commands.
Proof: unit tests over fixture repos per stack and a repo with krn.json; krn repo contract in this checkout prints source file.
Scope: src/repo/, src/cli/, test/, krn.json.
